ada.en: there is/are; to exist, to have

bangun.en: to wake up, to get up

bepergian.en: to travel, be away on a trip

beres-beres.en: to tidy up, clear things away

dibuang.en: to be thrown away, taken out (passive)

diganti.en: to be changed, be replaced (di- + ganti)

dihabiskan.en: to be finished off, used up

entah.en: who knows; no telling (entah ke mana = who knows where)

ganti.en: to change, replace (root): ganti baju = change clothes

keliling.en: to go around (root): berkeliling = tour around

kena.en: to get hit by, be caught by (kena macet = hit traffic)

kesiangan.en: up too late in the morning, overslept

lepas.en: to come off; loose (lepas landas = take off)

menurut.en: according to; in the opinion of

menyala.en: to be on, be lit (light, device)

mundur.en: to move back; pushed later (of a meeting)

naik.en: to ride, to board, to go up

pulang.en: to go home, to return home

sanggup.en: to be able to manage; willing and able

sempat.en: to have the chance or time

turun.en: to get off, to go down

ujung.en: end, tip: ujung jalan = end of the street
